impact: A relief bid for AI names should help NBIS, MU, DRAM and SNXX after the S&P's fourth straight loss, but hawkish Fed minutes could cap the bounce in growth stocks.
summary: US stock futures rose Wednesday after Nvidia's beat and $130B Q4 guide: one early report had Nasdaq 100 futures up 252 points (0.9%) and S&P 500 futures up 0.5%, while Benzinga later had Nasdaq 100 futures up 1.4% and S&P 500 futures up 0.8%. Nvidia traded about 2.8% to 3.7% higher premarket, and Nebius and CoreWeave were among AI infrastructure gainers. Minutes of the Oct 27-28 Fed meeting are due at 2 p.m. ET, with markets pricing about a 96% chance of a December hike, and Anthropic is set to price its IPO tonight.
title: Nasdaq futures up about 1% as Nvidia rises ~3% premarket; Fed minutes, Anthropic pricing today
